a: Bet sea bishvilan. kamma havu lehu – tere alfe vachamesh mea garmide; lechol chad kamma mate leh – tamne mea utelatin utelata vetilta; akkatti nefishi leh deulla! la dak.
Emor deamrinan la dak – lechumera; lekulla – la dak mi amrinan?!
Mi savrat beribbua ka amrinan?! beiggula ka amrinan!
Mikkede kamma merubba yoter al haiggul – revia; pashu lehu sheva mea veshittin utemanya; akkatti pash leh palga deammeta! hayeynu dela dak – ulechumera la dak.
Ta shema: hakkone ilan vekarkao – mevi vekore. may, lav kol shehu? lo; shesh esre amma.
Ta shema: kana shene ilanot betoch shel chavero – mevi veeno kore. ha shelosha – mevi vekore; may, lav kol shehu? la; hacha name shesh esre amma.
Ta shema, rabbi akiva omer: karka kol shehu – chayyayv bappea uvabbikkurim, vechotvin alav perozbul,
b: Veniknin immah nechasim sheen lahem achrayut! hacha bemay askinan – bechitte.
Dayka name, dekatane: kol shehu. shema minna.
Ta shema: ilan – miktzato baaretz umiktzato bechutz laaretz – tevel vechullin meoravin ze baze, divre rabbi.
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: haggadel bechiyyuv – chayyayv, haggadel biftur – patur.
Ad kan la peligi, ella demar savar: yesh berera, umar savar: en berera;
Aval gadel biftur – divre hakkol patur!
Hacha bemay askinan – demafsik tzunema. i hachi, may tameh derabbi? dehadri orvi.
Uvemay ka mippalgi? mar savar: avvera mevalbel, umar savar: hay lechodeh kae vehay lechodeh kae.
Veshesh esre amma – vetu la? veha tenan: marchikin et hailan min habbor, esrim vechamesh amma! amar abbaye: mezal – tuva azli, achchoshe la machchashi ella ad shesh esre amma, tefe la machchashi.
Ki ata rav dimi amar, bea minneh resh lakish merabbi yochanan: ilan hassamuch lammetzer betoch shesh esre amma, mahu? amar leh: gazlan hu, veen meviin mimmennu bikkurim.
Ki ata ravin amar rabbi yochanan: echad ilan hassamuch lammetzer, veechad ilan hannote – mevi vekore; sheal menat ken hinchil yehoshua leyisrael et haaretz.

Mishna ilan shehu note lisde chavero – kotzetz melo hammardea, al gabbe hammacharesha. uvecharuv uvashshikma – keneged hammishkolet. bet hashshelachin – kol hailan keneged hammishkolet. abba shaul omer: kol ilan serak keneged hammishkolet.
Gemara ibbaya lehu: abba shaul – aresha kae, o assefa kae?
Ta shema, detanya: bet hashshelachin – abba shaul omer: kol hailan keneged hammishkolet, mippene shehatztzel ra levet hashshelachin. shema minna: aresha kae! shema minna.

Amar rav ashe: matnitin name dayka, dekatane: "kol ilan serak". i amrat bishlama aresha kae – hayeynu dekatane kol ilan; ella i amrat assefa kae, ilan serak mibbee leh?! ella lav shema minna aresha kae? shema minna.

Mishna ilan shehu note lirshut harabbim, kotzetz kede sheyyehe gamal over – verochvo. rabbi yehuda omer: gamal taun pishtan o chavile zemorot. rabbi shimon omer: kol hailan keneged hammishkolet, mippene hattumea.
Gemara man tena devinzakin – batar umedana dehashta azlinan?

Amar resh lakish: bemachaloket shenuya, verabbi eliezer hi – ditnan: en osin chalal tachat reshut harabbim – borot, shichin umearot. rabbi eliezer mattir, bichde shettehe agala mehallechet – uteuna avanim.
Rabbi yochanan amar: afillu tema rabbanan, hatam – zimnin demafchit velav addateh, aval hacha – kamma kamma ka keyitz leh.
Rabbi yehuda omer: gamal taun pishtan o chavile zemorot. ibbaya lehu: shiura derabbi yehuda nefish, o dilma shiura derabbanan nefish?

Peshita deshiura derabbanan nefish! dei salka datach shiura derabbi yehuda nefish, rabbanan – beshiura derabbi yehuda hechi avdi? veella may, shiura derabbanan nefish? rabbi yehuda – beshiura derabbanan may aved? efshar digchin vechalef tuteh.
Rabbi shimon omer: kol hailan keneged hammishkolet, mippene hattumea. tana: mippene ohel hattumea. peshita, "mippene hattumea" tenan!
I mimmatnitin, hava amena: dilma mayyte orev tumea veshade hatam, vesagya bedachluli bealma; ka mashma lan:
Haderan alach la yachpor

a: Chezkat habbattim, vehabborot, vehashshichin, vehammearot, vehashshovachot, vehammerchatzaot, uvet habbaddin, uvet hashshelachin, vehaavadim, vechol shehu ose perot tadir – chezkatan shalosh shanim miyyom leyom.
Sede habbaal – chezkatah shalosh shanim, veenan miyyom leyom.
Rabbi yishmael omer: shelosha chodashim barishona, shelosha baacharona, ushenem asar chodesh baemtza; hare shemona asar chodesh.
Rabbi akiva omer: chodesh barishona, vechodesh baacharona, ushenem asar chodesh baemtza; hare arbaa asar chodesh.
Amar rabbi yishmael: bamme devarim amurim – bisde lavan, aval bisde ilan – kanas et tevuato, umasak et zetav, kanas et kayytzo – hare ellu shalosh shanim.

Gemara amar rabbi yochanan, shamati meholche usha shehayu omrim: minnayin lachazaka shalosh shanim? mishshor hammuad – ma shor hammuad, kevan shennagach shalosh negichot – nefak leh mechezkat tam, vekam leh bechezkat muad; hacha name, kevan deachla telat shenin – nefak la mershut mocher, vekayyma la birshut lokeach.
I – ma shor hammuad ad negicha reviit la michayyayv, hacha name, ad shana reviit la kayyma birshuteh! hachi hasheta?! hatam mikki negach shalosh negichot – have muad,
b: Veiddach, ki la negach – may leshallem? hacha, kevan deachla telat shene – kayyma la birshuteh.
Ella meatta, chazaka sheen immah taana tehve chazaka! allema tenan: kol chazaka sheen immah taana, enah chazaka?
Tama may – deamrinan: dilma kidkaamar, hasheta ihu la taen, anan liton leh?!
Matkef la rav avvira: ella meatta, mechaa shello befanav la tehve mechaa – dumeya deshor muad; ma shor hammuad befanav baenan, af hacha name befanav baenan!
Hatam – "vehuad bivalav" ketiv; hacha – chavrach chavra it leh, vechavra dechavrach – chavra it leh.
Ulerabbi meir, deamar: richek negichotav chayyayv, kerav negichotav lo kol shekken; achla telata pere bechad yoma – kegon teena, leheve chazaka!
Dumeya deshor hammuad, ma shor hammuad beiddana deit leh ha negicha leta leha negicha, hacha name beiddana deita lehay pera leta lehay pera.
Achla telata pere bitlata yome – kegon tzalaf, leheve chazaka! hatam pera miha iteh, umigmar hu deka gamar veazel.
Achla telata pere bitlatin yome – kegon aspasta, leheve chazaka! hechi dame – dekadaych veachla dekadaych veachla; hatam mishmat hu deka shamet veachel.
Achla telata pere bitlata yarche – kegon aspasta, leheve chazaka! man holche usha – rabbi yishmael; lerabbi yishmael hachi name –
Ditnan, rabbi yishmael omer: bamme devarim amurim – bisde hallavan, aval bisde ilan – kanas et tevuato, umasak et zetav, vechanas et kayytzo – hare ellu shalosh shanim.
Lerabbanan, may?
Amar rav yosef, kera ketiv: "sadot bakkesef yiknu vechatov bassefer vechatom" – shehare navi omed beeser, umazhir al achat esre.
Amar leh abbaye: dilma hatam etza tova ka mashma lan!

a: Dei la tema hachi, "benu vattim veshevu, venitu gannot veichlu et piryan" – may kaamar? ella etza tova ka mashma lan; hacha name – etza tova ka mashma lan. tidda, dichtiv: "unetattam bichli chares, lemaan yaamdu yamim rabbim".
Ella amar rava: shatta kammayyta machel inish, tarte machel, telat la machel.
Amar leh abbaye: ella meatta, ki hadra ara, tihdar levar mippere! allema amar rav nachman: hadra ara vehadri pere?
Ella, amar rava: shatta kammayyta la kafed inish, tarte la kafed, telat kafed.
Amar leh abbaye: ella meatta, kegon hane deve bar elyashiv – dekafdi afillu amman dechalef ammitzra didhu, hachi name dilaltar have chazaka? vechi tema hachi name, im ken natatta devarecha leshiurin!
Ella amar rava: shatta kammayyta mizdehar inish bishtareh, tarte utelat mizdehar, tefe la mizdehar.
Amar leh abbaye: ella meatta, mechaa shello befanav – la tihve mechaa, daamar leh: i machet beappay, hava mizdeharna bishtaray!
Deamar leh: chavrach chavra it leh, vechavra dechavrach – chavra it leh.

Amar rav huna: shalosh shanim sheamru, hu sheachalan retzufot. may kamashma lan? tenena: chezkatan shalosh shanim miyyom leyom! mahu detema, "miyyom leyom" leappoke mekuttaot – uleolam afillu mefuzzarot; ka mashma lan.
Amar rav chama: umode rav huna beatre demovri bage.

Peshita! la tzericha, deikka demovar veikka dela movar – vehay gavra movra; mahu detema, amar leh: im ita dedidach havay, ibbei lach lemizrea; ka mashma lan daamar leh: chada ara bechulleh baga – la matzena lintar.
Vei name, behachi nicha li – deavda tefe.
Tenan: chezkat habbattim. veha battim – devimama yadi, belelya la yadi!
Amar abbaye: man mashed abbattim – shivave; shivave midda yadi bimama uvelelya.
Rava amar: kegon deatu be tere, veamri: anan agrinan minneh, vedarenan beh telat shenin bimama uvelelya.
Amar leh rav yemar lerav ashe: hane nogin beedutan hen – dei la amri hachi, amrinan lehu: zilu havu leh agar beta lehay!
Amar leh: dayyayne dishfili hachi dayani. mi la askinan kegon dinkiti agar beta veamri: leman litteveh?
Amar mar zutera, vei taen veamar: leto tere sahadi leashode leh dedar beh telat shene bimama uvelelya – taneteh taana.
b: Umode mar zutera berochlin hammachazirin baayayrot, deaf al gav dela taan – taaninan leh anan.
Umode rav huna bechanvata demachoza – delimama avida, lelelya la avida.
Rame bar chama verav ukeva bar chama zevun hahi ammeta bahade hadade. mar ishtammash bah rishona shelishit vachamishit, umar ishtammash bah sheniyya reviit veshishshit. nefak arar illava,
Ato lekammeh derava, amar lehu: may tama avditu hachi – ki hechi dela tachzeku ahadade; ki hechi dildidchu la have chazaka, lealma name la have chazaka.
Vela amaran ella dela ketuv itra, aval ketuv itra – kala it leh.
Amar rava: achalah kullah, chutz mibbet rova – kana kullah, chutz mibbet rova.
Amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: vela amaran ella devar zeria hi, aval lav bar zeria hi – kane la aggav ara.
Matkef la rav bivi bar abbaye: ella meatta, tzunema – bamme yikne? ella beokome bah chevata umishtecha ba pere; hacha name – ibbei leh leokome bah chevata, i name mishtecha ba pere.
Hahu daamar leh lechavreh: may baet behay beta? amar leh: minnach zeventeh, vaachalit shene chazaka. amar leh: ana bishchune gauoe havay.
Ata lekammeh derav nachman, amar leh: zil beror achiltach. amar leh rava: hachi dina?! hammotzi mechavero alav haraya!
Verame derava adderava, verame derav nachman adderav nachman – dehahu

a: Daamar leh lechavreh: kol nichse deve bar sisin – mezabbena lach. havay hahi ara dahava mikkere "deve bar sisin". amar leh: ha lav deve bar sisin hi, veikkeroye hu demikkarya "deve bar sisin". ato lekammeh derav nachman, okma bida delokeach. amar leh rava: dina hachi?! hammotzi mechavero alav haraya!
Kashya derava adderava, kashya derav nachman adderav nachman.
Derava adderava la kashya – hatam mocher kae benichseh, hacha lokeach kae benichseh.

Derav nachman adderav nachman name la kashya – kevan daamar leh: deve bar sisin, umikkarya "deve bar sisin", aleh dideh ramya legalloye delav deve bar sisin hi; aval hacha, lo yehe ella denaket shetara – mi la amrinan leh: kayyem shetarach vekum benichse?

Hahu daamar leh lechavreh: may baet behay beta? amar leh: minnach zeventeh, vaachalteh shene chazaka. amar leh: beshuke barae havay. amar leh: veha it li sahadi dechol shatta hava atet telatin yome! amar leh: telatin yome – beshukay hava teridna. amar rava: avid inish dechol telatin yome terid beshuka.
Hahu deamar leh lechavreh: may baet behay ara? amar leh: mippelanya zeventa, deamar li dezavna minnach. amar leh: at lav ka modet
b: Dehay ara didi hi, veat la zeventa minnay? zil, lav baal devarim didi at. amar rava: dina kaamar leh.
Hahu deamar leh lechavreh: may baet behay ara? amar leh: mippelanya zeventa, vaachaltiha shene chazaka. amar leh: pelanya gazlana hu.
Amar leh: veha it li sahadi daatay immelachi bach, vaamart li: "zil zevoyn"! amar leh: hashsheni noach li; harishon kashe hemennu. amar rava: dina kaamar leh.
Keman, keadmon? ditnan: haorer al hassade vechatum aleha beed – admon omer: hashsheni noach li; harishon kashe hemennu. vachachamim omrim: ibbed et zechuto.
Afillu tema rabbanan – hatam avad leh maase; aval hacha dibbura – avid inish demikkere veamar.

Hahu deamar leh lechavreh: may baet behay ara? amar leh: mippelanya zeventa, vaachaltiha shene chazaka. amar leh: pelanya gazlana hu! amar leh: veha it li sahadi daatet beureta, vaamart li: zavna nihali! amar leh: amena ezbon dinay. amar rava: avid inish dezaven dineh.
Hahu daamar leh lechavreh: may baet behay ara? amar leh: mippelanya zeventa, vaachaltiha shene chazaka. amar leh: veha nekitna shetara dizvani lay minneh ha arbei shene!
Amar leh: mi savrat "shene chazaka" – telat shene ka amena?! shene chazaka tuva ka amena. amar rava: avidi inashe dekaru lishne tuva "shene chazaka".
Vehane mille deachla sheva – dikdem chazaka dehay lishtara dehach;

a: Aval shet – en lecha mechaa gedola mizzo.
Ze omer: "shel avotay", veze omer: "shel avotay"; hay ayyti sahade daavahateh hi, vehay ayyti sahade deachla shene chazaka –
Amar rabba: ma lo leshakker? i bae amar leh: minnach zeventa vaachaltiha shene chazaka. amar leh abbaye: "ma li leshakker" bimkom edim – la amrinan.
Hadar amar leh: in, daavahatach hi – uzeventa minnach; vehay daamari lach daavahati, dismich li ala kedaavahati.
Toen vechozer vetoen, o en toen vechozer vetoen? ulla amar: toen vechozer vetoen. nehardae amri: eno toen vechozer vetoen.
Umode ulla hecha daamar leh: shel avotay velo shel avotecha – deeno toen vechozer vetoen. vehecha dahava kae be dina vela tean, vaata meabbaray utean – eno chozer vetoen. may tama? taneteh agmereh.

Umodu nehardae hecha daamar leh: shel avotay shellekachuha meavotecha – dechozer vetoen. vehecha deishtai mille abbaray vela tean, vaata leve dina utean – dechozer vetoen. may tama? avid inish dela megalle taneteh ella leve dina.
Amar ammemar: ana nehardaa ana, usevira li detoen vechozer vetoen. vehilcheta: toen vechozer vetoen.
Ze omer: shel avotay, veze omer: shel avotay; hay ayyti sahade daavahateh veachla shene chazaka, vehay ayyti sahade deachla shene chazaka.
Amar rav nachman: oki achila levahade achila, veoki ara bechezkat avahata. amar leh rava: ha edut muchecheshet hi! amar leh: nehi deittachchash baachilta,
b: Baavahata mi ittachchash?!
Lema rava verav nachman – biflugeta derav huna verav chisda kamippalgi?

Deittemar: shete kitte edim hammachchishot zo et zo – amar rav huna: zo baa bifne atzmah umeida, vezo baa bifne atzmah umeida. verav chisda amar: bahade sahade shakkare lema li? lema rav nachman – deamar kerav huna, verava kerav chisda?
Allibba derav chisda – kulle alma la feligi, ki peligi – allibba derav huna. rav nachman – kerav huna. verava – ad kan la kaamar rav huna ella leedut acheret, aval leotah edut – la.
Hadar ayyti sahade daavahateh hi. amar rav nachman: anan achatinneh, anan massekinan leh; leziluta deve dina la chayyshinan.

Metiv rava, veittema rabbi zeera: shenayim omrim met, ushenayim omrim la met; shenayim omrim nitgarsha, ushenayim omrim lo nitgarsha – hare zo lo tinnase, veim nisset lo tetze. rabbi menachem berabbi yose omer: tetze.
Amar rabbi menachem berabbi yose: ematay ani omer tetze – bizman shebbau edim veachar kach nisset; aval nisset veachar kach bau edim – hare zo lo tetze.
Amar leh: ana sevari lemebad ovada; hasheta deotevtan at, veotvan rav hamenuna besureya – la avedna ba ovada.
Nefak avad ovada. man dachaza, savar: tauta hi bideh; vela hi, ella mishshum detalya beashle ravreve –

Ditnan, rabbi yehuda omer: en maalin lakkehunna al pi ed echad. amar rabbi elazar: ematay – bimkom sheyyesh orrin, aval bimkom sheen orrin – maalin lakkehunna al pi ed echad. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer mishshum rabbi shimon ben hassegan: maalin lakkehunna al pi ed echad.
Rabban shimon ben gamliel hayeynu rabbi elazar! vechi tema: arar chad ikka benayyhu – rabbi elazar savar: arar chad,

a: Verabban shimon ben gamliel savar: arar – tere; vehaamar rabbi yochanan: divre hakkol en arar pachot mishshenayim!

Ella arar tere; vehacha bemay askinan – kegon demachzekinan leh baavu dehay – dechohen hu; unefak aleh kala deven gerusha uven chalutza hu, veachatinneh; vaata ed echad veamar dechohen hu, veassekinneh;
Vaato be tere veamri deven gerusha vachalutza hu, veachatinneh; vaata ed echad veamar dechohen hu. udechulle alma – mitztarfin edut,

Vehacha bemechash leziluta deve dina ka mippalgi – rabbi elazar savar: kevan deachatinneh – la massekinan leh, chayyshinan leziluta deve dina. verabban shimon ben gamliel savar: anan achatinneh, vaanan massekinan leh; uleziluta deve dina la chayyshinan.
Matkef la rav ashe: i hachi, may irya chad? afillu bitre name! ella amar rav ashe: dechulle alma la chayyshinan leziluta deve dina; vehacha – biltzaref edut ka mippalgi. uviflugeta dehane tannae –

Detanya: leolam en edutan mitztarefet, ad sheyyiru shenehen keechad. rabbi yehoshua ben karcha omer: afillu beze achar ze. en edutan mitkayyemet bevet din, ad sheyyaidu shenehem keechad. rabbi natan omer: shomin devarav shel ze hayyom, ulichsheyyavo chavero lemachar – shomin devarav.
Hahu daamar lechavreh: may baet behay ara? amar leh: minnach zeventa, veha shetara.
b: Amar leh: shetara zayyfa hu! gechen lechesh leh lerabba: in, shetara zayyfa hu; mihu shetara mealleya hava li, veirchas, veamena: enkoyt hay biday kol dehu.
Amar rabba: ma lo leshakker? i bae, amar leh: shetara mealleya hu. amar leh rav yosef: ammay samchat – ahay shetara; hay shetara chaspa bealma hu.

Hahu deamar lechavreh: hav li mea zuzi demassekna bach, veha shetara. amar leh: shetara zayyfa hu. gechen lechesh leh lerava: in, shetara zayyfa; mihu shetara mealleya hava li, veirchas, veamena: enkot hay biday kol dehu.
Amar rabba: ma lo leshakker? i bae, amar leh: shetara mealleya hu. amar leh rav yosef: ammay ka samchat – ahay shetara; hay shetara chaspa bealma hu.

Amar rav idi bar avin: hilcheta kevoteh derabba beara, vehilcheta kevoteh derav yosef bezuze. hilcheta kerabba beara – dehecha dekayyma ara, tekum. vehilcheta kevoteh derav yosef bezuze – dehecha dekayymi zuze, lokmu.
Hahu arva daamar leh lelove: hav li mea zuzi difrati lemalve illavach, veha shetara. amar leh: lav perataych? amar: lav hadart shekaltinhu minnay?

Shalcha rav idi bar avin lekammeh deabbaye: ki hay gavvna may? shelach leh abbaye: may tibbee leh? ha ihu deamar: hilcheta kevoteh derabba beara, vehilcheta kevoteh derav yosef bezuze – dehecha deokmu zuze, lokmu!
Vehane mille, deamar leh: hadart oziftinhu minnay. aval amar leh: haddartinhu nihalach mechamat dahavo shayyfi vesummake – akkatti iteh leshibuda dishtara.
Rava bar sharshum nafek aleh kala deka achel ara deyatme. amar leh abbaye: ema li izi, gufa deovada hechi hava? amar leh: ara bemashkanta hava naketna meavuhon deyatme; vahava li

a: Zuzi acharine gabbeh, vaachalta shene mashkanta.

Amena: i mahdarna la ara leyatme, veamena deit li zuzi acharine gabbe daavuchon – amur rabbanan: habba lippara minnichse yetomim – lo yippara ella bishvua. ella echbesheh lishtar mashkanta, veochla shiur zuze, demiggo dei baena amena lekucha hi beyadi – mehemanna, ki amena deit li zuzi gabbayychu – mehemanna.
Amar leh: "lekucha beyadi" la matzet amrat – deha ikka ala kala deara deyatme hi. ella zil ahdera nihalayyhu, vechi gadli yatme – ishtai dina bahadayyhu.
Keriveh derav idi bar avin shechev, ushevak dikla. rav idi bar avin amar: ana karivna tefe; vehahu gavra amar: ana karivna tefe. lesof odi leh deihu kariv tefe, okma rav chisda bideh.

Amar leh: layhdar li pere daachal mehahu yoma ad hasheta! amar: ze hu sheomrim alav adam gadol hu? amman ka semich mar – ahay; ha kaamar daana mekaravna tefe! abbaye verava la sevira lehu ha derav chisda,
b: Kevan deodi – odi.
Ze omer: "shel avotay", veze omer: "shel avotay"; hay ayyti sahadi daavahateh hu, vehay ayyti sahadi daachal shene chazaka –
Amar rav chisda: ma lo leshakker? i bae, amar leh: minnach zeventa vaachaltiha shene chazaka. abbaye verava la sevira lehu ha derav chisda – "ma li leshakker" bimkom edim – la amrinan.
Hahu daamar leh lechavreh: may baet behay ara? amar leh: minnach zevani, vaachaltiha shene chazaka. azal ayyti sahadi deachla tarte shene. amar rav nachman: hadra ara, vehadri pere.

Amar rav zevid: im taan veamar "leferot yaradti" – neeman. lav mi amar rav yehuda: hay man denaket maggala vetuvalya, veamar: ezil egdereh ledikla diflanya, dezabbeneh nihali – meheman? alma la chatzif inish degazar dikla delav dileh; hacha name, la chatzif inish lemechal pere delav dileh.
I hachi, ara name! ara, amrinan leh: achvi shetarach. i hachi, pere name! shetara lefere la avdi inashe.

Hahu daamar lechavreh: may baet behay ara? amar leh: minnach zevanit, vaachaltiha shene chazaka. ayyti chad sahada deachla telat shene. sevur rabbanan kammeh deabbaye lememar: hayeynu nesacha derabbi abba –
Dehahu gavra dachataf nesacha mechavreh. ata lekammeh derabbi amme, hava yatev rabbi abba kammeh. ayyti chad sahada demichtaf chatafa minneh. amar leh: in, chatafi – vedidi chatafi. amar rabbi amme:

a: Hechi nidayyeynu dayyayne lehay dina? lishallem? lekka tere sahadi! liftereh? ikka chad sahada! lishteva, ha amar michtaf chatfa, vechevan deamar dechatfa – have leh kegazlan!
Amar lehu rabbi abba: have mechuyyav shevua sheeno yachol lishshava, vechol hamechuyyav shevua sheeno yachol lishshava – meshallem.
Amar lehu abbaye: mi dame?! hatam sahada leoroe kaate – ki ate acharina bahadeh, mappekinan la minneh; hacha lesayyoe ka ate – ki ata acharina, mokminan la bideh!
Ella i damya ha derabbi abba – lechad sahada uletarte shene – ulefere.
b: Hahu arba dahavo minnetzu ala be tere, hay amar: "didi hi", vehay amar: "didi hi". ata chad minnayyhu leve dina, veamar: tifsuha addemayytena sahade dedidi hi. tafsinan, o la tafsinan? rav huna amar: tafsinan. rav yehuda amar: la tafsinan.

Azal, vela ashkach sahade. amar lehu: appekuha, vechol deallim gavar. mappekinan, o la mappekinan? rav yehuda amar: la mappekinan. rav pappa amar: mappekinan. vehilcheta: la tafsinan, vehecha ditfas – la mappekinan.
Ze omer: "shel avotay", veze omer: "shel avotay" – amar rav nachman: kol deallim gavar. umay shena mishshene shetarot hayyotzin beyom echad –

a: Derav amar: yachloku, ushemuel amar: shuda dedayyayne? hatam, lekka lemekam ala demilleta; hacha, ikka lemekam ala demilleta.
Umay shena meha ditnan: hammachalif para bachamor, veyalda; vechen hammocher shifchato, veyalda – ze omer: "ad shello macharti yalda", veze omer: "mishshellakachti yalda" – yachloku?
Hatam, lehay
b: It leh derara demamona, ulehahu it leh derara demamona; hacha, i demar – la demar, vei demar – la demar.
Amri nehardae: im ba echad min hashshuk, vehechzik bah – en motziin otah miyyado. detane rabbi chiyyay: gazlan shel rabbim lav shemeh gazlan.
Rav ashe amar: leolam shemeh gazlan, umay "la shemeh gazlan"? shello nittan lehishshavon.

Chozkatan shalosh shanim miyyom leyom vechulei. amar rabbi abba: i dale leh ihu gufeh tzanna defere, lealtar have chazaka. amar rav zevid, veim taan veamar: "leferot horadtiv" – neeman. vehane mille betoch shalosh, aval leachar shalosh – la.
Amar leh rav ashe lerav kahana: i lefira achateh, may hava leh lemebad? amar leh: ibbei leh lemachoye.

Dei la tema hachi, hane mashkenata desura, dichtiv behu: "bemishlam shenayya illen tippok ara da bela kesaf"; i kavesh leh lishtar mashkanta gabbeh, veamar: lekucha hi beyadi, hachi name dimheman? metakkeni rabbanan midde deate beh lide peseda?! ella ibbei leh lemachoye; hacha name, ibbei leh lemachoye.
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: yisrael habba mechamat goy – hare hu kegoy; ma goy – en lo chazaka ella bishtar, af yisrael habba mechamat goy – en lo chazaka ella bishtar. amar rava, vei amar yisrael:

a: "Ledidi amar li goy, deminnach zavna" – meheman. mi ikka midde deillu goy amar – la meheman, veillu amar yisrael mishshemeh degoy – meheman?!
Ella amar rava, i amar yisrael: "kamme didi zavna goy minnach, vezabbena nihali" – meheman, miggo dei bae amar leh: ana zeventa minnach.
Veamar rav yehuda: hay man denaket maggala vetuvalya, veamar: "ezil egzere ledikla diflanya, dizventeh minneh" – meheman, la chatzif inish lemigzar dikla delav dileh.
Veamar rav yehuda: hay man deachzek migguda daarode ulevar, la have chazaka. may tama? memar amar: kol dezara name arode achli leh.
Veamar rav yehuda: achalah orla – enah chazaka. tanya name hachi: achalah orla, sheviit vechilayim – enah chazaka.
Amar rav yosef: achla shachat – la have chazaka. amar rava: vei betzavvar machoza kayyma – have chazaka.
Amar rav nachman: tafticha – la have chazaka. appek kora veayyel kora – la have chazaka.
Vehane deve resh galuta – la machzeki ban, vela machzekinan behu.
Vehaavadim vechulei. avadim yesh lahem chazaka?! vehaamar resh lakish: haggodrot – en lahen chazaka! amar rava: en lahen chazaka lealtar, aval yesh lahen chazaka leachar shalosh shanim.
Amar rava: im haya katan muttal baarisa – yesh lo chazaka lealtar. peshita! la tzericha, deit leh imma; mahu detema: nechush dilma immeh ayyelteh lehatam; kamashma lan – imma la menashsheya bera.

Hanhu izze daachalu chushela binhardea. ata mare chushela, tafsinhu, vahava ka taen tuva. amar avu dishmuel: yachol liton ad kede demehen – dei bae, amar: lekuchot hen beyadi. vehaamar resh lakish: haggodrot – en lahen chazaka! shane izze, dimsira leroe.
Veha ikka tzafra ufanya! binhardea tayyayi shechichi, umiyyeda lida meshallemi.
Rabbi yishmael omer: shelosha chodashim vechulei. lema nir ikka benayyhu – derabbi yishmael savar: nir la have chazaka, verabbi akiva savar: nir have chazaka?
Vetisbera?! lerabbi akiva – may irya chodesh?
b: Afillu yom echad name! ella dechulle alma – nir la have chazaka; vehacha – pera rabba ufera zuta ikka benayyhu.

Tanu rabbanan: nir – eno chazaka. veyesh omrim: hare ze chazaka. man "yesh omrim"? amar rav chisda: rabbi acha hi – detanya: narah shana, uzeraah shetayim, narah shetayim, uzeraah shana – enah chazaka. rabbi acha omer: hare zo chazaka.

Amar rav ashe: sheelit kol gedole haddor, veamru li: nir – hare ze chazaka. amar leh rav bivi lerav nachman: may tama deman deamar: nir have chazaka? la avid inish decharyvu leh leareh – veshatek. umay tama deman deamar: nir la have chazaka? memar amar: kol shibba veshibba dichrava, leayyel beh.
Shelachu leh bene pum nahara lerav nachman bar rav chisda: yelammedenu rabbenu, nira – have chazaka, o la have chazaka? amar lehu, rabbi acha vechol gedole haddor amri: nir – hare ze chazaka.
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: revuta lemichshav gavre?! ha rav ushemuel bevavel, verabbi yishmael verabbi akiva beeretz yisrael, amri: nir la have chazaka!

Rabbi yishmael verabbi akiva – matnitin hi; rav – may hi? deamar rav yehuda amar rav: zo divre rabbi yishmael verabbi akiva, aval chachamim omrim: chezkatah shalosh shanim miyyom leyom. "miyyom leyom" lemaote may? lav lemaote nir – dela?

Shemuel – may hi? deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: zo divre rabbi yishmael verabbi akiva, aval chachamim omrim: ad sheyyigdor shalosh gederot, veyivtzor shalosh betzirot, veyimsok shalosh mesikot. may benayyhu? amar abbaye: dekel naara ikka benayyhu – sheose shalosh peamim beshana.

Amar rabbi yishmael: bamme devarim amurim – bisde hallavan. amar abbaye: midderabbi yishmael nishma lerabbanan, hayu lo sheloshim ilanot – mimmatta asara levet sea; achal asara beshana zo, vaasara beshana zo, vaasara beshana zo – hare zo chazaka.

a: Lav mi amar rabbi yishmael: chad pera have chazaka lechullehu pere? hacha name – hane havu chazaka lehane, vehane havu chazaka lehane.
Vehane mille hecha dela appiku, aval appiku vela achal – la havya chazaka. vehu devazzi bazzoze.

Ze hechzik bailanot, veze hechzik bakkarka – amar rav zevid: ze kana ilanot, veze kana karka. matkef la rav pappa: im ken, en lo levaal ilanot bakkarka kelum; lema leh baal karka levaal ilanot: akor ilanach, shekol vezil! ella amar rav pappa: ze kana ilanot vachatzi karka, vaze kana chatzi karka.
Peshita – machar karka, veshiyyer ilanot lefanav – yesh lo karka. vaafillu lerabbi akiva, deamar: mocher beayin yafa mocher, hane mille gabbe bor vadut –
Dela machchashu beara, aval ilanot,
b: Dekamachchashi beara – shayyore shayyayr. dei la shayyayr, lema leh: akor ilana vezil.
Machar ilanot veshiyyer karka lefanav – pelugeta derabbi akiva verabbanan; lerabbi akiva deamar: mocher beayin yafa mocher – it leh; lerabbanan – let leh.

Lerabbi akiva it leh – vaafillu lerav zevid deamar: en lo – hane mille gabbe shene lakochot, deamar leh: ki hechi dildidi let li beilanot, ledidach name let lach bekarka; aval hacha – mocher beayin yafa mocher.

Lerabbanan let leh – vaafillu lerav pappa deamar: yesh lo – hane mille gabbe shene lakochot, deamar leh: ki hechi dildidach zabben beayin yafa, ledidi name zabben beayin yafa; aval hacha – mocher beayin raa mocher.
Amri nehardae: achalan retzufin – en lo chazaka. matkef la rava: ella meatta, hay meshara deaspasta – bemay kane la? ella amar rava: mecharan retzufin – en lo karka.
Amar rabbi zera: ketannae – kerem shehu natua al pachot mearba ammot, rabbi shimon omer: eno kerem. vachachamim omrim: hare zo kerem, veroin et haemtzaiyyim keillu enan.
Amri nehardae: hay man dezaven dikla lechavreh – kane leh mishshippuleh ad tehoma.

a: Matkef la rava, velema leh: kurekma derishka zabbeni lach, akor kurekma derishka, vezil! ella amar rava: beva mechamat taana.
Amar leh mar kashshisha bereh derav chisda lerav ashe: vei kurekma derishka zabben leh, may hava leh lemebad? ibbei leh lemachoye.

Dei la tema hachi, hane mashkenata desura – dichtiv behi hachi: "bemishlam shenayya illen, tippok ara da bela kesaf"; i kavesh leh lishtar mashkanta, veamar: "lekucha hi beyadi" – hachi name dimheman?! meytakkeni rabbanan milleta deate ba lide feseda? ella ibbei leh lemachoye; hacha name, ibbei leh lemachoye,

Mishna shalosh aratzot lachazaka – yehuda, veever hayyarden, vehaggalil. haya bihuda vehechezik baggalil, baggalil vehechezik bihuda – enah chazaka, ad sheyyehe immo bimdina achat. amar rabbi yehuda: lo amru shalosh shanim, ella kede sheyyehe beaspamya – veyachzik shana, yelchu veyodiuhu shana, veyavo leshana acheret.
Gemara may kasavar tanna kamma? i kasavar mechaa shello befanav havya mechaa, afillu yehuda vegalil name! i kasavar mechaa shello befanav la havya mechaa, afillu yehuda vihuda name la!
Amar rabbi abba bar memel amar rav, leolam kasavar: mechaa shello befanav havya mechaa, umishnatenu – bishat cherum shanu. umay shena yehuda vegalil denaket?
Ha ka mashma lan –
b: Distam yehuda ugelil, kishat cherum damu.
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: en machazikin benichse voreach. ki amrita kammeh dishmuel, amar li: vechi limchot befanav hu tzarich?!
Verav – may ka mashma lan? mechaa shello befanav la havya mechaa?! vehaamar rav: mechaa shello befanav havya mechaa! rav – tama detanna didan kamfaresh, veleh la sevira leh.
Veikka deamri, amar rav yehuda amar rav: machazikim benichse voreach. ki amrita kammeh dishmuel, amar li: peshita! vechi limchot befanav hu tzarich?!
Verav – may ka mashma lan? mechaa shello befanav havya mechaa?! veha amra rav chada zimna! ella ha ka mashma lan – daafillu micha bifne shenayim sheen yecholin lomar lo, havya mechaa –

Deamar rav anan: ledidi mipparsha li minneh demar shemuel: micha bifne shene bene adam sheyyecholim lomar lo – havya mechaa, micha bifne shene bene adam sheen yecholin lomar lo – la havya mechaa. verav – chavrach chavra it leh, vechavra dechavrach chavra it leh.
Amar rava, hilcheta: en machzikin benichse voreach, umechaa shello befanav havya mechaa. tarte?! la kashya; kan boreach mechamat mamon, kan boreach mechamat meradin.
Hechi dame mechaa? amar rav zevid: "pelanya gazlana hu" – la havya mechaa. "pelanya gazlana hu, denaket la learay begazlanuta,

a: Velimchar tavana leh bedina" – havya mechaa.
Amar "la temru leh", may? amar rav zevid: ha kaamar "la temru leh"! rav pappa amar: ledideh la temru leh, leacharine emaru lehu – chavrach chavra it leh, chavra dechavrach chavra it leh.

Amaru leh: "la amrinan leh" – amar rav zevid: ha ka amaru leh "la amrinan leh"! rav pappa amar: ledideh la amrinan leh, leacharine amri lehu – chavrach chavra it leh, vechavra dechavrach chavra it leh.

Amar lehu: "la tippok lechu shuta" – amar rav zevid: ha kaamar "la tippok lechu shuta"! amaru leh: "la mappekinan shuta" – amar rav pappa: ha kaamri leh "la mappekinan shuta"! rav huna bereh derav yehoshua amar: kol milleta dela ramya aleh deinish, amar la velav addateh.

Amar rava amar rav nachman: mechaa shello befanav havya mechaa. etiveh rava lerav nachman – amar rabbi yehuda: lo amru shalosh shanim, ella kede sheyyehe beaspamya veyachzik shana, veyelchu veyodiuhu shana, veyavo leshana acheret. vei salka datach mechaa shello befanav havya mechaa, lema li lemete? littev hatam adducheteh, velimache! hatam etza tova ka mashma lan, denete venishkol ara ufere.
Middeka motev leh rava lerav nachman – mikkelal dela sevira leh demechaa shello befanav havya mechaa; vehaamar rava: mechaa shello befanav havya mechaa! batar deshama merav nachman, savra.

Ashkechinhu rabbi yose berabbi chanina letalmidav derabbi yochanan, amar lehu: mi amar rabbi yochanan mechaa – bechamma? rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: mechaa bifne shenayim. rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan: mechaa bifne shelosha.
Lema bidrabba bar rav huna ka mippalgi – deamar rabba bar rav huna: kol milleta demitamra beappe telata,
b: Let bah mishshum lishshana bisha; man deamar bifne shenayim – let leh derabba bar rav huna, uman deamar bifne shelosha – it leh derabba bar rav huna?

La, dechulle alma it lehu derabba bar rav huna; vehacha beha ka mippalgi – man deamar bifne shenayim, kasavar: mechaa shello befanav la havya mechaa. uman deamar bifne shelosha, kasavar: mechaa shello befanav havya mechaa.

I baet ema: dechulle alma – mechaa shello befanav havya mechaa; vehacha beha kamippalgi – man deamar bifne shenayim, savar: sahaduta baenan. uman deamar bifne shelosha, kasavar: galloye milleta baenan.

Giddel bar minyome hava leh machuyata lemachoye. ashkechinhu lerav huna ulechiyyay bar rav ulerav chilkiyya bar tovi dahavo yatvi, umacha kammayyhu. leshana – hadar ata lemachoye, amaru leh: la tzerichat, hachi amar rav: kevan shemmicha shana rishona, shuv eno tzarich lemachot. veikka deamri, amar leh chiyyay bar rav: kevan shemmicha shana rishona, shuv en tzarich lemachot.
Amar resh lakish mishshum bar kappara: vetzarich lemachot besof kol shalosh veshalosh. tahe ba rabbi yochanan: vechi gazlan yesh lo chazaka?! "gazlan" salka datach?! ella "kegazlan" yesh lo chazaka.
Amar rava: hilcheta – tzarich lemachot besof kol shalosh veshalosh. tane bar kappara: irer, chazar veirer, chazar veirer – im mechamat taana rishona irer, en lo chazaka. veim lav – yesh lo chazaka.
Amar rava amar rav nachman: mechaa – bifne shenayim,

a: Veen tzarich lomar "ketovu"; modaa – bifne shenayim, veen tzarich lomar "ketovu";
Hodaa – bifne shenayim, vetzarich lomar "ketovu"; kinyan – bifne shenayim, veeno tzarich lomar "ketovu"; vekiyyum shetarot bishlosha;
Siman – 185.
Amar rava: i kashya li, ha kashya li – hay kinyan, hechi dame? i kemaase bet din dame, live telata! i la kemaase bet din dame, ammay eno tzarich lomar "ketovu"?
Batar devae, hadar pashta: leolam lav kemaase bet din dame; vehacha, tama may deeno tzarich lomar "ketovu" – mishshum distam kinyan lichtiva omed.
Rabba verav yosef deamri tarvayyhu: la katvinan modaa, ella amman dela tzayet dina. abbaye verava deamri tarvayyhu: afillu alay vealecha. amri nehardae: kol modaa
b: Dela ketiv bah: "anan yadinan beh beunesa diflanya" – lav modaa hi.
Modaa demay? i degitta udemattanta – galloye milleta bealma hi! vei dizvine, vehaamar rava: la katvinan modaa azzevine!

Leolam dizvine; mode rava hecha daanis – uchemaase defardesa; dehahu gavra demashken pardesa lechavreh litlat shenin. batar deachla telat shene chazaka, amar: i mezabbenat li – mutav, vei la – kaveshna lishtar mashkanta, veamena: "lekucha hi beyadi". kehay gavvna katvinan modaa.

Amar rav yehuda: hay mattanta temirta – la magbenan ba. hechi dame mattanta temirta? amar rav yosef, deamar lehu lesahadi: "zilu ittammuru vechitvu leh". veikka deamri: amar rav yosef, dela amar lehu: "tittevu beshuka uvevarayata vetichtevu leh". may benayyhu? ikka benayyhu setama.
Amar rava: vehavya modaa lachaverta. amar rav pappa: ha derava – lav beferush ittemar, ella mikkelala ittemar.

Dehahu gavra daazal lekaddoshe itteta, amara leh: "i katvat li kullehu nichsaych – havena lach, vei la – la havena lach". azal katveh la lechullehu nichse. ata bereh kashshisha, amar leh: "vehahu gavra – ma tihve aleh?" amar lehu lesahade: "zilu ittammuru baavar yammina, vechitvu leh". ato lekammeh derava, amar lehu: la mar kena, vela mar kena.
Man dachaza, savar – mishshum dehavya modaa lachaverta. vela hi; hatam – mochcha milleta demechamat unesa hu dichtav la; aval hacha – mar nicha leh delikne, umar la nicha leh delikne.
Ibbaya lehu:

a: Setama may? ravina amar: la chayyshinan, rav ashe amar: chayyshinan. vehilcheta: chayyshinan:
Mishna kol chazaka sheen immah taana, enah chazaka. ketzad? amar lo: "ma atta ose betoch shelli?" vehu amar lo: "shello amar li adam davar meolam" – enah chazaka.
"Shemmacharta li"; "shennatatta li bemattana"; "avicha mechara li"; "avicha netanah li bemattana" – hare zo chazaka. vehabba mishshum yerushsha – eno tzarich taana.
Gemara peshita!

Mahu detema: hay gavra – mizban zevina leh hay ara, ushetara hava leh veirchas; vehay dekaamar hachi – savar: i amena mizban zevina li hay ara, amri li: achvi shetarach; hilkach lema leh anan: dilma shetara hava lach veirchas, kegon ze – "petach picha laillem" hu; ka mashma lan.
(Enav siman)
Rav anan shekal bidka beareh. azal haddar guda beareh dechavreh. ata lekammeh derav nachman, amar leh: zil haddar.
Veha achzeki li! amar leh: keman – kerabbi yehuda verabbi yishmael, deamri: kol befanav – lealtar have chazaka? let hilcheta kevotayyhu.
Amar leh: veha achel – daata vesayyay beguda bahaday! amar leh: mechila betaut hi. at gufach – i hava yadat la avadt; ki hechi deat la hava yadat, hu name la hava yada.
Rav kahana shekal bidka beareh. azal haddar guda beara dela dideh.
b: Ata lekammeh derav yehuda. azel ayytay tere sahade, chad amar: tarte utzeyayta al, vechad amar: telat utzeyayta al. amar leh: zil shallem tarte miggo telat.

Amar leh: keman? kerabbi shimon ben elazar – detanya, amar rabbi shimon ben elazar: lo nechleku bet shammay uvet hillel al shete kitte edim – sheachat omeret mane, veachat omeret matayim – sheyyesh bichlal matayim mane.
Al ma nechleku? al kat achat – sheechad omer mane, veechad omer matayim; shebbet shammay omrim: nechleka edutan, uvet hillel omrim: yesh bichlal matayim mane.
Amar leh: veha mayytina lach iggarta mimmareva, deen halacha kerabbi shimon ben elazar! amar leh: lechi tayte.

Hahu gavra, dedar bekashta beillita arba shene. ata mare deveta, ashkecheh. amar leh: may baet behay beta? amar leh: mippelanya zeventa, dezavna minnach. ata lekammeh derabbi chiyyay, amar leh: i it lach sahade dedar bah ihu dizvant minneh, vaafillu chad yoma – okemna la bidach; vei la – la.

Amar rav: hava yatevna kammeh dechabbivi, vaamari leh: vechi en adam asuy likkach velimkor ballayla? vachaziteh ledateh, i amar leh: kammay didi zavna minnach – meheman, miggo dei bae amar leh: ana zeventa minnach.
Amar rava: kevoteh derabbi chiyyay mistabbera, dekatane: habba mishshum yerushsha – eno tzarich taana. taana hu dela bae, ha reaya bae.
Vedilma la reaya bae, vela taana bae! veibbaet ema: shane lokeach – dela shade zuzi bichdi.
Ibbaya lehu: nira bo, may? amar abbaye: hi hi. rava amar: avid inish desayar areh vela zaven.
Shelosha lakochot mitztarfin. amar rav: vechullam bishtar.
Lememra desavar rav: shetar it leh kala, veedim let lehu kala? vehaamar rav: hammocher sade beedim, gove minnechasim meshuebadim! hatam, lakochot

a: Inhu afsidu annafshayyhu.
Umi amar rav hachi? vehatnan: hammalve et chavero bishtar – gove minnechasim meshuebadim, al yede edim – gove minnechasim bene chorin!
Vechi tema: rav tanna hu ufaleg, veha rav ushemuel deamri tarvayyhu: milve al pe – eno gove lo min hayyorshim velo min hallakochot!
Milve azzevine ka ramet?! milve, ki ka yazef – betzina ka yazef, ki hechi dela littazlu nichseh aleh. zevine, man dezaven ara – befarhesya zaven, ki hechi delippok la kala.
Tanu rabbanan: achalah haav shana vehabben shetayim; haav shetayim vehabben shana; haav shana, vehabben shana, vehallokeach shana – hare zo chazaka.

Lememra delokeach it leh kala?! ureminhi: achalah bifne haav shana uvifne habben shetayim; bifne haav shetayim uvifne habben shana; bifne haav shana, uvifne habben shana, uvifne lokeach shana – hare zo chazaka. vei salka datach lokeach it leh kala, en lecha mechaa gedola mizzo!
Amar rav pappa: ki tanya hahi – bemocher sedotav setam.

Mishna haummanin, vehashshuttafin, vehaarisin, vehaappotroppin – en lahem chazaka. lo laish chazaka benichse ishto, velo laishsha chazaka benichse baalah; velo laav benichse habben, velo labben benichse haav.
Bamme devarim amurim – bemachzik; aval benoten mattana, vehaachin shechalku, vehammachzik benichse hagger – naal vegader ufaratz kol shehu – hare zo chazaka.
b: Gemara avu dishmuel velevi tanu: shuttaf en lo chazaka, vechol shekken umman. shemuel tane: umman en lo chazaka, aval shuttaf yesh lo chazaka. veazda shemuel letameh – deamar shemuel: hashshuttafin machzikin ze al ze, umeidin ze al ze, venaasim shomre sachar ze laze.

Rame leh rabbi abba lerav yehuda bimarta deve rav zakkay, mi amar shemuel: shuttaf yesh lo chazaka? vehaamar shemuel: shuttaf keyored birshut dame. lav lememra deshuttaf en lo chazaka? la kashya; ha dinchet lechulla, ha dinchet lefalga.
Amri la lehay gisa, veamri la lehay gisa.
Ravina amar: ha veha dinchet lechulla; vela kashya – ha deit bah din chalukah, ha delet bah din chalukah.
Gufa – amar shemuel: shuttaf – keyored birshut dame. may ka mashma lan, shuttafut en lo chazaka? lema: shuttaf en lo chazaka!
Amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: lomar shennotel bashshevach hammaggia lichtefayim – besade sheenah asuya litta, kesade haasuya litta.
Umeidin ze laze.

a: Ammay? nogin beedutan hen!

Hacha bemay askinan – dichtav leh: "din udevarim en li al sade zo". vechi ketav lo may have? vehatanya, haomer lachavero: "din udevarim en li al sade zo"; veen li esek bah"; veyaday mesullakot hemenna – lo amar kelum!
Hacha bemay askinan – keshekkanu miyyado. vechi kanu miyyado may have? hare maamidah bifne baal chovo –
Deamar ravin bar shemuel mishshemeh dishmuel: hammocher sade lachavero shello beachrayut – en meid lo aleha, mippene shemmaamidah bifne baal chovo!
Hacha bemay askinan – dekabbel aleh achrayut. achrayut deman? i nema achrayut dealma, kol shekken denicha leh! ella achrayut deatya leh mechamateh.

Vechi mesallek nafsheh minneh – mi mistallak? vehatanya: bene ir shennignav sefer tora shellahen, en danin bedayyayne otah hair, veen meviin reaya meanshe otah hair. veim ita, lisalleku be tere minnayyhu, velidayynu!
Shane sefer tora, delishmia kae.
Ta shema: haomer "tenu mane livne iri" – en danin bedayyayne otah hair, veen meviin reaya meanshe otah hair. ammay? lisalleku be tere nafshayyhu, velidayynu!
Hacha name besefer tora.

Ta shema: haomer "tenu mane laaniyye iri" – en danin bedayyayne otah hair, veen meviin reaya meanshe otah hair. vetisbera – aniyyim shakli, dayyayne mippasli?! ella ema: en danin bedayyayne aniyye otah hair, veen meviin reaya meaniyye otah hair. veammay? listalleku be tere nafshayyhu, velidayynu!
Hacha name besefer tora. veammay kare lehu "aniyyim"? dehakkol etzel sefer tora – aniyyim hen.
Veibbaet ema: leolam kidkatane – aniyyim mammash, uveanye deramu alayyhu. vehechi dame? i dekitz lehu – littevu be tere minnayyhu may dekitz lehu, velidayynu!
Hacha bemay askinan – dela kitz lehu. veibbaet ema: leolam dekitz lehu, venicha lehu – dechevan deravavch, ravavch.
Venaashin shomre sachar ze laze.
b: Ammay? shemira bivalim hi! amar rav pappa, deamar leh: shemor li hayyom, vaani eshmor lecha lemachar.

Tanu rabbanan: machar lo bayit, machar lo sade – en meid lo aleha, mippene sheachrayuto alav. machar lo para, machar lo tallit – meid lo aleha, mippene sheen achrayuto alav. may shena resha umay shena sefa?
Amar rav sheshet: resha – biruven sheggazal sade mishshimon, umecharah lelevi, vaata yehuda veka mearer; dela lezil shimon lashed leh lelevi, denicha leh dehadra.
Vechevan deashed leh delevi hu, hechi matze mappek la minneh? deamar: yadana dehay ara delav dihuda hi. uvehahu zechuta deka mappek la millevi – laypka mihuda?
Deamar: hashsheni noach li, harishon kashe hemennu.
Vei baet ema: kegon deit leh sahade lemar veit leh sahade lemar, vaamur rabbanan: ara, hecha dekayyma – tekum.

a: Velokma begazlan!
Mishshum deka bae lemitna sefa: machar lo para, machar lo tallit – dedavka machar, dehave leh yeush veshinnuy reshut; aval lo machar, dehadra leh – la; tena resha name machar.
Vesefa name – nehi demiyyayash miggufay, middemeha mi miyyayash? la tzericha, demit gazlan – ditnan: haggozel umaachil et banav, vehinniach lifnehem – peturim milleshallem.
Velokma beyoresh!
Hanicha leman deamar: reshut yoresh lav kirshut lokeach dame – shappir; ella leman deamar: reshut yoresh kirshut lokeach dame – may ikka lememar?
Veod kashya leh leabbaye: mippene sheachrayuto alav" veen achrayuto alav"?! mippene shehi chozeret lo" veenah chozeret lo" mibbee leh!
Ella kidravin bar shemuel – deamar ravin bar shemuel mishshemeh dishmuel: hammocher sade lachavero shello beachrayut – en meid lo aleha, mippene shemmaamidah bifne baal chovo.
Vedavka bayit o sade, aval para vetallit – la mibbaya
b: Bistama dela mishtabeda leh, may tama? mittaltele ninhu, umittaltele levaal chov la mishtabedi – veaf al gav dichtav leh miggelima deal katpeh, hane mille deitanhu beenayyhu, aval letanhu beenayyhu – la;
Ella afillu asao appoteke – name la. may tama? kidrava – deamar rava: asa avdo appoteke umecharo – baal chov gove mimmennu. shoro vachamoro appoteke umecharo – en baal chov gove hemennu,
May tama? hay it leh kala, veha let leh kala.

Velechush dilma akni leh mittaltele aggav mekarkee! deamar rabba: i akni leh mittaltele aggav mekarkee – kane mekarkee kane mittaltele. veamar rav chisda: vehu dichtav leh: "dela keasmachta udela ketufesa dishtare".
Hacha bemay askinan – kegon shellakach, umachar lealtar.
Velechush dilma "deekne" hu! shamat minna: "deekne"; kana umachar, kana vehorish – lo mishtabed?
La tzericha, dekaamri edim: yadinan beh behay dela hava leh ara meolam.
Vehaamar rav pappa, af al gav daamur rabbanan: hammocher sade lachavero shello beachrayut, uva baal chov uterafah – eno chozer alav; nimtzet sheenah shello – chozer alav!
Hacha bemay askinan – bemakkir bah shehi bat chamoro.
Verav zevid amar: afillu nimtzet sheenah shello – eno chozer alav, daamar leh: lehachi zabbeni lach shello beachrayut.
Gufa – amar ravin bar shemuel mishshemeh dishmuel: hammocher sade lachavero shello beachrayut – en meid lo aleha, mippene shemmaamidah bifne baal chovo. hechi dame?

a: I deit leh ara achariti, aleh dideh hadar! i delet leh ara achariti, may nafka leh minna?
Leolam delet leh ara achariti, deamar: la nicha delehve "love rasha velo yeshallem".
Sof sof, legabbe iddach name – "love rasha velo yeshallem" hu! deamar: lehachi zabbeni lach shello beachrayut.
Machrez rava, veittema rav pappa: desalkin leella udenachatin letatta; hay bar yisrael dezaven leh chamara leyisrael chavreh, veka ate goy veanes leh minneh, dina hu dimfatztze leh minneh.
Vela amaran ella sheeno makkir bah shehi bat chamoro, aval makkir bah shehi bat chamoro – la. vela amaran ella dela anes leh ledideh uleukkafa, aval anes leh ledideh uleukkafa – la.
Ammemar amar: afillu lekka kol hane – la. may tama? midda yada distam goy annas hu – shenneemar: "asher pihem dibber shav viminam yemin shaker".

Umman en lo chazaka vechulei. amar rabba: lo shanu ella shemmasar lo beedim, aval masar lo shello beedim – mittoch sheyyachol lomar lo "lo hayu devarim meolam", ki amar leh name "lekucha hi beyadi" – meheman.
Amar leh abbaye: i hachi, afillu beedim name – mittoch sheyyachol lomar lo: "hechzartiv lecha", ki amar leh: "lekucha hi beyadi" – meheman!
Amar leh rabba: mi savrat
b: Hammafkid etzel chavero beedim – eno tzarich lehachezir lo beedim? la salka datach – ella hammafkid etzel chavero beedim, tzarich lehachazir lo beedim.

Metivi abbaye: raa avdo beyad umman, vetallito beyad koves, amar lo: "ma tivo etzlecha?" "atta mecharto li", "atta netatto li bemattana" – lo amar kelum. "befanay amarta lo lemochro velitteno lo bemattana" – devarav kayyaymin.
May shena resha umay shena sefa?

Amar rabba: sefa – beyotze mittachat yede acher, vekaamar leh acher: befanay amarta lo lemochro velitteno bemattana. miggo dei bae amar leh: "minnach zevanteh", ki amar leh name: "befanay amarta lo lemochro" – devarav kayyaymin, umeheman.
Katane mihat resha: "raa". hechi dame? i deikka edim – lema li raa? nayte edim venishkol! ella lav delekka edim? vechi raa miha tafes leh!
La, leolam deikka edim; vehu deraa.
Veha at hu deamrat: hammafkid etzel chavero beedim, tzarich leforo beedim! amar leh: hadari bi.

Metiv rava lesayyoe lerabba: hannoten tallito leumman, umman omer: shetayim katzatzta li, vehalla omer: lo katzatzti lecha ella achat. kol zeman shehattallit beyad umman – al baal habbayit lehavi reaya. netanah lo – bizmanno, nishba venotel. avar zemanno, hammotzi mechavero alav haraya.
Hechi dame? i deikka edim, lichze edim may kaamri!

a: Ella lav delekka edim? vekatane: umman meheman – miggo dei bae amar leh "lekucha hi beyadi", meheman name aagreh!
La, leolam delekka edim; vehu delo raa.
Metiv rav nachman bar yitzchak: umman en lo chazaka. umman hu deen lo chazaka – ha acher yesh lo chazaka.
Hechi dame? i deikka edim, acher – ammay yesh lo chazaka? ella lav delekka edim? vekatane: umman en lo chazaka. teyuveta derabba! teyuveta.

Tanu rabbanan: nitchallefu lo kelim bechelim bevet haumman – hare ze yishtammesh bahen, ad sheyyavo halla veyittol et shello. bevet haevel o bevet hammishte – hare ze lo yishtammesh bahen, ad sheyyavo halla veyittol et shello. may shena resha umay shena sefa?
Amar rav: hava yatevna kammeh dechabbivi, vaamar li: vechi en adam asuy lomar laumman "mechor li talliti"?!
Amar rav chiyyay bereh derav nachman: lo shanu ella hu, aval ishto uvanav – lo. vehu name – la amaran ella daamar leh: "tallit" setam, aval "tallitcha" – la, hay lav tallit dideh hu.

Amar leh abbaye lerava: ta achvi lach rammae defumebdita, may avdi. amar leh: "hav li sarbalay". "lo hayu devarim meolam". "ha it li sahadi dechazyu gabbach!" amar leh: "hahu acharina hava". "appekinneh venechzinhu!" amar leh: "ivra la mappekna leh".
Amar rava: shappir kaamar leh –
b: "Raa" tanya.

Amar rav ashe: vei chakkim, meshavve leh "raa" – deamar leh: ammay tefisat leh, lav mishshum deit lach gabbay? hasheta appekinhu veshayyeminhu – shekol at didach, veeshkol ana didi. amar leh rav acha bereh derav avya lerav ashe, matze amar leh: la tzerichna leshuma didach, kevar shamuah kammae dekammach.
Aris en lo chazaka. ammay? ad haiddana palga, vehasheta kulla! amar rabbi yochanan: baarise batte avot.
Amar rav nachman: aris shehorid arisin tachtav – yesh lo chazaka. may tama? dela avid inash denachati arise leareh, veshatek.
Amar rabbi yochanan: aris shechillek laarisin – en lo chazaka. may tama? emor haremanya bealma shavveyu.
Shelach leh rav nachman bar rav chisda lerav nachman bar yaakov, yelammedenu rabbenu: aris meid, o eno meid? hava yatev rav yosef kammeh, amar leh: hachi amar shemuel: aris meid. vehatanya: eno meid!
La kashya – ha deikka pera beara, veha delekka pera beara.
(Amalek siman)
Tanu rabbanan: arev meid lallove, vehu deit leh ara achariti. malve meid lallove, vehu deit leh ara achariti.
Lokeach rishon meid lelokeach sheni, vehu deit leh ara achariti.
